paper_title: Spectra of axions emitted from main sequence stars
suggested_experiment_name: NuSTAR StAB (stellar axion background from main sequence stars)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper derives a NEW 95% CL exclusion limit on the axion-photon coupling g_agamma from a chi-squared fit of the Stellar Axion Background (StAB) decay X-ray signal against NuSTAR cosmic X-ray background data (Fig. 7). This is an astrophysical/cosmological bound (decay of star-sourced axions), NOT a dark-matter haloscope, so no local DM density is assumed. The exclusion region spans roughly ma ~ 0.5-30 keV with g_agamma between ~2e-11 and the cooling/globular-cluster bound of 6.6e-11 GeV^-1 ('slightly below the cooling bound'). No numerical table is provided; data_points are approximate reconstructions from the figure axis ranges (y-axis 1e-11 to 1e-10 GeV^-1) and the text description, hence moderate-low extraction confidence.
